20028.long_desc: The Arcooda Multiside Deluxe Cocktail Table is the premium sitdown arcade cocktail table machine with steel and plywood construction, offering 26 inch arcade HD LCD monitor, Japanese Sanwa joysticks and buttons, 2.1 subwoofer sound system, and endless features that include adjustable height and advanced maintenance features. The cabinet features plywood and steel construction for durability and reliability, a 26 inch high resolution LCD monitor for a brighter and sharper image, adjustable joysticks which can be changed between 4 and 8 way play, adjustable leg height, metal cashbox with a separate coin entry door (both lockable), low maintenance design. Play in traditional vertical cocktail mode where the games flip for each player. Or, play side by side for 2 player titles. Key features on the Arcooda multi-side deluxe cocktail table include; MONITOR: low lag time and designed for arcade use, the 26inch HD monitor supports VGA and HDMI inputs with resolution up to 1080P. Monitor adjustments are at the front of the machine for easy handling. SOUND: with 2.1 audio sound system, this custom sound package was designed for arcade, including subwoofer. Adjust the sound via volume control and separate subwoofer volume control. CONTROLS: features Japanese made joystick and buttons. Sanwa are the world's premium arcade controllers offering years of trouble free operation. CABINET: 18mm plywood cabinet with black laminated panels, together with 2mm steel powder coated joystick control panel assemblies. The cabinet has a number of height positions allowing you to adjust the height to match your playing position. COIN MECH: with multi-coin mechanism, accept $20, $1 and $2 coins, or leave on free play. COMPONENTS: Internally, we use 6 input Philips power board for easy upgrade to PC, Raspberry Pi, etc… with Jamma wiring system and breakout cables available (optional). The machine also includes +5V 20A +12V 8A power supply. CONSTRUCTION: the woodgrain cocktail table has control panels, legs and cash box made from 2mm steel (powder coated in black), whilst timber is made from hard 18mm laminated plywood. The cabinet has separate coin entry door, and metal cashbox, as well as additional safety sections for the home user. We use 8mm tempered glass with clear finish. EASY ACCESS:the top of our cocktail table can be unlatched and opens up for easy inspection. We use reinforced glass and it is an easy process if you would like to add your own graphics or designs. The user control panels are also very easy to access, unlatch from inside the machine, you can quickly make any repairs to buttons/joysticks, or adjust the joystick for different game play. There are no bolts or keys needed to open the panel, all can be handled from inside the machine. MODULAR HARDWARE: we have introduced a modular construction to the cabinet, parts are easily removed and replaced. Owners do not need full knowledge of electronics - for example, we have upgraded the power supply to have internal LED light (if all is working well the light is on, if the light is off you know that the power supply may be faulty) and the wiring into the cabinet is via plug (unplug the cable and replace the entire power supply - no need for soldering, or re-attaching power cables and high voltage leads). Everything has been designed for easy use and easy repair. INTUITIVE DESIGN: internal operator/owner control panel is easy to use, and includes service and credit switches, left and right volume control for dual speakers and coin meter for arcade operation. ADAPTABLE: the arcade machine has variable height positions (suitable for children or adults), and also has additional 4 feet which can be used to stop any movement and to stabilize the machine on uneven ground. CUSTOMIZABLE: add your own designs to the Table Top. Full flexibility is available to you. WARRANTY: * 3 year unlimited warranty (this means, you can operate this machine in your arcade centre, or street location, or in your games room) with full confidence. Register your Arcooda machine online to join the owner's community for benefits such as set up videos, firmware updates, special downloads, exclusive discounts, technical support and the owners forum.
